title: UTR Rating Monthly Rollup
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utr:rating
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(rating_value) as total_value avg(match_count) as avg_duration count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarizes utr rating by month so you can review season-to-date volume without digging through individual sessions.
value: A monthly rollup is useful for spotting big directional changes and for keeping a simple log of a long season.
implementation: Retain at least a season of history so month-over-month comparisons stay meaningful.
visualization: Column chart of monthly totals with average session duration overlaid.
grandmaExplanation: It records the bigger month-by-month picture for utr rating instead of one session at a time.
